role: Main-file of the HRV detail screen pushed from the Dashboard HRV chip: hero RMSSD with z-score verdict, HR strip, autonomic capacity card, trend rows (RMSSD vs the recovery baseline, the rest vs the 30-day reliable-overnight archive average), plus the async loaders for the full RR series, the trend averages and the Beat Consistency priors baseline. Charts/engine-room/Beat Consistency card live in HRVDetailV2View+Charts.swift.
types: HRVDetailV2View.HRVVerdict: enum — Excellent/Good/Fair/Low verdict for today's RMSSD
HRVDetailV2View.TrendAverages: struct (Sendable) — 30-day means of RMSSD, SDNN, mean HR and stress index
toplevel: Stored-property initializers only: @ScaledMetric sizes bound to text styles (11..56pt), @State defaults (engineRoomTab=.timeDomain, flags false, arrays empty, optionals nil). EngineTab raw values are English strings 'Time','Frequency','Nonlinear','ANS','Quality'. Header doc (lines 4-23) describes the trend rows' two comparisons, the Frequency tab's short-reading explanation (under ~60 clean beats) and the >10% artifact caution banner. The Trend Analysis members sit in a same-file extension (split from the struct body to keep it under the type-length limit); a file-scope trendMean helper follows it.

flags.text: `recentSessions` is no longer read by the view (the trend rows load their averages from the archive); callers in DashboardV2View/MainTabView and the snapshot tests still pass it.

units.does: Maps an EngineTab case to its localized display name from LanguageManager.appBundle.
Returns today's analysis-window RMSSD (result.timeDomain.rmssd).
Computes the hero verdict from RMSSD and the personal ln(RMSSD) baseline mean/SD.
Localized verdict word: Excellent/Good/Fair/Low.
Pill fill colour per verdict from the Wong palette.
Pill text colour per verdict (contrast-safe *Text variants).
Classifies RMSSD: with a baseline, z = (ln(max(1,rmssd)) - mean)/sd and bands z>=0.5 excellent, >=-0.5 good, >=-1.5 fair, else low; without baseline uses absolute RMSSD 60/45/30 ms cut-offs.

branches.cond: mean and sd both non-nil and sd > 0
branches.effect: true: z-score path (lines 169-173); false: absolute fallback at 176

units.does: Resets every per-session piece of state (load flags, Beat Consistency result, fullRRSeries, rrPlotPoints, trendAverages), loads the full RR series, then the 30-day trend averages, then the Beat Consistency priors baseline, returning early if the task was cancelled between steps.

true: returns before the priors walk; false: loads the Beat Consistency baseline

units.does: Retrieves the full session off-main via RRCollector; returns without writing anything if the task was cancelled meanwhile (a newer session's load superseded it); otherwise stores a non-empty rrSeries in fullRRSeries (left nil by loadDetail's reset when there is none), builds sampled plot points from effectiveRRSeries and sets rrLoadCompleted.

branches.effect: returns: no state written, so a superseded load cannot land under the new session

branches.cond: full session found AND rrSeries non-empty
branches.effect: true: fullRRSeries = series; false: fullRRSeries stays nil (reset by loadDetail), effectiveRRSeries falls back to session.rrSeries; retrieve failure is logged by retrieveOrLog

units.does: Collects up to 28 prior overnight session ids, asks the shared BeatConsistencyPriorsCache to warm them (ids are queued onto a walk already in flight), polls for cached features, then (if not cancelled) scores tonight off-main against them and sets baselineLoadCompleted.

branches.effect: true: returns without storing (view gone); false: stores results

units.does: Local computed accessor for the BeatConsistencyPriorsCache (override substitute or .shared).
Returns up to 28 overnight session ids from the archive index snapshot (newest-first), excluding the current session.

Polls the priors cache every 0.5 s (max 40 ticks ≈20 s) until min(minNightsForLowConfidence, ids.count) priors are cached or the warm walk ends; returns all cached features for the ids and logs a debug summary.

branches.cond: cachedCount < needed AND cache.isWarming AND waitedTicks < 40
branches.effect: true: sleep 0.5 s and recount; false: stop waiting (enough cached, walk finished, or 20 s elapsed) and return what is cached
true: breaks out of loop, returns partial result; false: continue

units.does: Builds a Beat Consistency baseline from the prior nights' features and scores tonight's RR series (with artifact flags and sleep bounds, defaulting to 0..durationMs) on a detached userInitiated task.

branches.effect: false: returns nil (card shows empty state); true: continue
nil flags → []: BeatConsistency.score treats empty flags as all-clean (BeatConsistency.swift:215)
